schemas.config: CREATE TABLE config (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
schemas.scenes: CREATE TABLE scenes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
schemas.recall_tombstones: CREATE TABLE recall_tombstones (scene_id TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL, recalled_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scene_id,message_id))
schemas.memories:
CREATE TABLE memories (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scope_key TEXT NOT NULL, person_id TEXT,
        content TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, value TEXT NOT NULL
      )
schemas.memory_sources:
CREATE TABLE memory_sources (
        memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        scene_id TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL, sender_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(memory_id,scene_id,message_id)
      )
schemas.memory_deleted: CREATE TABLE memory_deleted (fingerprint TEXT PRIMARY KEY, deleted_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schemas.memory_vectors:
CREATE TABLE memory_vectors (
        memory_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        space_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vector_spaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        embedding BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(memory_id,space_id)
      )
schemas.memory_supports:
CREATE TABLE memory_supports (
        memory_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES memories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        value TEXT NOT NULL
      )
schemas.memory_relation_entities: CREATE TABLE memory_relation_entities(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL)
schemas.memory_relation_candidates: CREATE TABLE memory_relation_candidates(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL,target_id TEXT NOT NULL,admission_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,version INTEGER NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL)
schemas.memory_relation_tombstones: CREATE TABLE memory_relation_tombstones(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER NOT NULL)
schemas.memory_commitment_heads: CREATE TABLE memory_commitment_heads(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL)
schemas.memory_commitment_revisions: CREATE TABLE memory_commitment_revisions(id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(id,version))
schemas.memory_commitment_commands: CREATE TABLE memory_commitment_commands(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,id TEXT NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL)
schemas.memory_projection_outbox:
CREATE TABLE memory_projection_outbox (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        version INTEGER NOT NULL, deletion_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        state TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        available_at INTEGER NOT NULL, lease_token TEXT, lease_until INTEGER,
        updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT,
        UNIQUE(assertion_id,version,deletion_epoch,kind),
        CHECK(kind IN ('lexical','person')),
        CHECK(state IN ('pending','leased','done','invalid','failed'))
      )
schemas.memory_person_projection_state:
CREATE TABLE memory_person_projection_state (
        assertion_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version INTEGER NOT NULL, deletion_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
        scope_key TEXT NOT NULL, person_id TEXT, refreshed_at INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
schemas.memory_assertion_state:
CREATE TABLE memory_assertion_state (
        assertion_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        deletion_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, deleted INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
schemas.memory_assertion_revisions:
CREATE TABLE memory_assertion_revisions (
        assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memory_assertion_state(assertion_id),
        version INTEGER NOT NULL, scope_key TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at TEXT,
        idempotency_key TEXT, payload_hash TEXT, value TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY(assertion_id,version), UNIQUE(assertion_id,idempotency_key)
      )
schemas.memory_assertion_revision_sources:
CREATE TABLE memory_assertion_revision_sources (
        assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        scene_id TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(assertion_id,version,scene_id,message_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(assertion_id,version) REFERENCES memory_assertion_revisions(assertion_id,version) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
schemas.memory_assertion_revision_parents:
CREATE TABLE memory_assertion_revision_parents (
        assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, parent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY(assertion_id,version,parent_id),
        FOREIGN KEY(assertion_id,version) REFERENCES memory_assertion_revisions(assertion_id,version) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
schemas.memory_command_receipts:
CREATE TABLE memory_command_receipts (
      command_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, deletion_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
      result_version INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL

schemas.memory_knowledge_edges: CREATE TABLE memory_knowledge_edges(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,assertion_id TEXT NOT NULL,admission_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,value TEXT NOT NULL)
schemas.memory_semantic_candidates: CREATE TABLE memory_semantic_candidates(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,input_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,version INTEGER NOT NULL,value TEXT)
schemas.memory_commitment_transitions: CREATE TABLE memory_commitment_transitions(id TEXT NOT NULL,mutation_version INTEGER NOT NULL,scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(id,mutation_version))
schemas.memory_commitment_temporal_windows: CREATE TABLE memory_commitment_temporal_windows(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,scene_id TEXT NOT NULL,value TEXT NOT NULL)
